Intelligent Tennis Game Tracker
==================================================
1. Waits for first serve position
2. Tracks ball through each point
3. Detects when point ends (out, net, double bounce)
4. Automatically waits for next serve
5. Press 'D' to advance frame by frame
6. Press 'N' to mark net area (6 points clockwise)
7. Press 'S' to mark serve area (4 points)
8. Press 'B' to open ball HSV debug window
9. Press SPACE to play/pause
10. Press BACKSPACE to step back one frame
11. Press 0/1/2/3 for HSV debug on previous frame (standard/alt1/alt2/alt3)
12. Press 'Q' to quit
